name: Craftsman's Writ: Minor Recombobulator
summary: A faded writ requests a Minor Recombobulator and gives details for delivery and payment. It can be transferred to another holder.

sections.title: A Written Request
sections.body: A customer’s faded note asks you to provide one Minor Recombobulator. It also gives a delivery location and payment details, and says the writ may be transferred. You need the writ in hand to complete the exchange.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The writ requests one Minor Recombobulator.

faq.q: Can I give this writ to someone else?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: What do I need to complete the exchange?
aliases: what do i need for delivery
faq.answer: You need the requested Minor Recombobulator and the writ in your possession. The note gives the delivery location and payment details.
